summary.text: Cameron Reid is One Nation's candidate for Point Cook at the 2026 Victorian election. According to the ABC's guide he has spent around 30 years in emergency response work with the Victorian Department of Justice and also holds licences as a real estate agent and buyer's agent. His One Nation candidate page refused automated requests, so we could not read it, and no other source we could use had published more about him as at early November 2026.

occupation.text: Real estate agent and buyer's agent

sources.title: Point Cook: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Keith Meure is the Family First candidate for Point Cook at the 2026 Victorian election. He has spent 25 years in visual effects for film, including at Framestore Melbourne, and has a background in theatre and acting. A married father of two, he leads worship and children's ministry at Lightpoint Church.

prior_roles.note: His party page lists Framestore Melbourne among his visual effects employers without dates.

prior_roles.role: Worship leader and children's ministry leader

priorities.text: Parental rights in education, with parents kept informed about decisions affecting their children
Opposing abortion and euthanasia
Freedom of speech and of religion
More openness about school curriculum, including content on gender
Representing the concerns of Point Cook families

sources.title: Point Cook: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Keith Meure, Family First Party Australia

summary.text: Kirti Alle is a candidate for Point Cook at the 2026 Victorian election; the ABC's guide lists the party as The Republican. Neither the ABC nor any party or campaign page we could find had published a biography as at early November 2026.

sources.title: Point Cook: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Mark Grech is The West Party's candidate for Point Cook at the 2026 Victorian election. He runs a small business, is married with a young child, and says he has lived in the City of Wyndham for about 40 years. His campaign page argues that Melbourne's western suburbs have been overlooked as they have grown, naming crime, infrastructure and local heritage as concerns.

priorities.text: More attention for Melbourne's west, which he says has been neglected through rapid growth
Tackling rising crime
Better local infrastructure
Support for local heritage
Let’s not neglect the west any longer.

sources.title: Point Cook: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Mark Grech, The West Party for Point Cook

summary.text: Mathew Hilakari has been the Labor MP for Point Cook since the seat was first contested in 2022. Before Parliament he was a researcher and writer and had worked in the offices of state and federal MPs. He became Parliamentary Secretary for Education in August 2026 and is recontesting Point Cook in 2026.

prior_roles.role: Member, Public Accounts and Estimates Committee
Staff member for state and federal MPs

faction.name: Socialist Left
faction.note: Wikipedia says he was the Socialist Left's state convener before his 2022 election; it doesn't say whether he still belongs to it.

priorities.text: Better infrastructure
Continued improvement in public health and education
A fairer society

summary.text: Paul Kelly is the Labour DLP candidate for Point Cook at the 2026 Victorian election, on the VEC's list of nominations. The ABC's guide gave no biography for this candidate as at 9 Nov 2026, and we found no other published profile.

summary.text: Ponraj Krishna Pandi is the Greens candidate for Point Cook at the 2026 Victorian election. A first-generation migrant from India, he is a site reliability engineer in the IT industry and describes himself as a community organiser in Point Cook. He was the Greens candidate for the federal seat of Gellibrand in 2025, winning about 17 per cent of the vote.

priorities.text: More funding for schools
Better public transport
Greater investment in housing, education, transport and health care

sources.title: Point Cook: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Ponraj Krishna Pandi, Candidate for Point Cook, Australian Greens
Candidates of the 2025 Australian federal election, Wikipedia

summary.text: Raja Reddy is the Liberal candidate for Point Cook at the 2026 Victorian election. He is a migration agent with his own business, president of Wyndham Diwali, and sits on a Liberal Party committee for community engagement. He was the Liberal candidate for Laverton at the 2022 state election.

occupation.text: Migration agent and small business owner

priorities.text: Tackling crime in Point Cook, backing the Liberal plan for 3000 more police and tougher sentencing
Lowering costs for families and businesses, including a $50 weekly cap on tolls

sources.title: Point Cook: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Candidates of the 2022 Victorian state election, Wikipedia

summary.text: Taylor Laine is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Point Cook at the 2026 Victorian election. Laine works as a hairdresser and has lived in Melbourne's western suburbs for about five years. On the party's campaign page Laine argues that working people in the west have been left behind, and lists climate action, anti-racism, queer advocacy and solidarity with Palestine among long-held causes.

priorities.text: an economy and society that puts people before profit
Access to education from early childhood through to TAFE or university, along with public services, transport and infrastructure
Action on climate change
Opposing racism and the rise of the far right, and advocating for the queer community
Peace and justice for Palestine

sources.title: Point Cook: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
